about: Hand decisions about ME2 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book). Every one was read off the page image; none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.

match     {page, header}: the printed page in the entry's own booklet, and the start of the entry's header; codes, the seven rank codes, where the header's start names two entries on the page (Gal and GALACTUS, Resource p.4)
{summary}: a Pregenerated Heroes Summary row (PDF 51), by the name the chart prints
verdict   misprint          the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
as_printed        the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why
summary_misprint  the chart prints a value its own ranks contradict and the character's block does not; 'printed' is the chart's, 'corrected' the block's
also      further values of the same block, each {verdict, field, printed, and corrected for a misprint}: one override matches one block, and a block can print more than one thing to explain
checked   the date the page image was read

A number inside its rank's range but not its standard (25 Ex, 250 Shift Y, 750 Shift Z, 2000 Cl 1000; ranks.json min and max) is as_printed: the Health or Karma beside it adds up with that number, so the book means it. Survey decision 3 (apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/me2.md) offers teaching the check a rank's range instead; these overrides are the way ME1's Superkree was kept until that is decided.

overrides.note: Printed Karma: Unlimited, and Resources: Unlimited. His R, I and P are 5000 Cl 5000 each. Health 20,000 = 4 x 5000 holds.
25 is inside Excellent (16-25) and 250 inside Shift Y (176-350). Health 1550 = 25 + 25 + 500 + 1000 and Karma 1000 = 250 + 250 + 500 use them.
Health 1300 = 25 + 25 + 250 + 1000 and Karma 1000 = 500 + 250 + 250 use the in-range numbers.
Health 1300 = 25 + 25 + 250 + 1000 and Karma 1000 = 250 + 500 + 250 use the in-range numbers.

Printed A 100 Shift X and E 100 Shift X: 100 is Unearthly, and Shift X is 126-175. Health 950 = 500 + 100 + 250 + 100 agrees with the numbers, so the codes are the misprint. S 250 Shift Y is in range and the Health uses it.
The Resource Book's block. Health 600 = 150 + 50 + 150 + 250 uses the in-range 250.
The Resource Book's block. Health 1100 = 250 + 250 + 100 + 500 uses the in-range 250s.

A one-line grid in Chapter 7, Ac's and Tus's ranks added together as the text says: E 2000 with Cl 1000 set on two lines, and 750 Z (Shift Z, 351-999) for R, I and P. Health 2600 = 50 + 50 + 500 + 2000 and Karma 2250 = 3 x 750.
The chart's own row gives R 30 + I 50 + P 30 = 110, and Firelord's block (Adventure p.5) prints 110. ME1's chart has the same misprint.
